description:
Activate Myr Welder using Timeless Lotus's ability by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
If Staff of Domination is exiled, activate Myr Welder using Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Otherwise, activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Myr Welder. Then, activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
